steps.title: Set protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Specify the number of DNA columns for the run and select the P20 multi‑channel pipette mount (left or right) as required.

steps.title: Add water to PCR wells
steps.instruction: Dispense 3 µL of water into each well of the PCR plate using the P20 multi‑channel pipette (mounted as specified), employing a single column of tips and the multi‑dispensing function.

steps.title: Add Kapa enzyme to wells
steps.instruction: Dispense 10 µL of Kapa enzyme into each well using the same single column of tips (no tip change) as for water.

steps.title: Add primer number to wells
steps.instruction: Using a fresh tip for each well, dispense 1 µL of the designated primer number into each PCR well.

steps.title: Add primer letter to wells
steps.instruction: Using a fresh tip for each well, dispense 1 µL of the designated primer letter into each PCR well.

steps.title: Add DNA to PCR wells
steps.instruction: Using a fresh tip for each well, dispense 5 µL of DNA into each PCR well.
